review_method: Independent pinned-v1 full-text review, not abstract/bibliography-only; reading scope recorded per paper, without claim of exhaustive proof/figure validation.

task_binding.scope: A pretrained deterministic scalar regression model faces changed input distributions. Deployment has unlabeled target inputs and no source examples or target labels. Source preparation may retain a documented finite summary of aggregate statistics, not original source examples. Do not assume the model already provides a predictive probability distribution.
task_binding.resource_distinction: No scientific numeric source-summary ceiling; package runtime budgets are separate.

label_semantics.core: High-priority lineage or access-regime comparator; not necessarily directly applicable or mandatory.
label_semantics.background: Conceptual/mechanistic support for interpreting approaches and evidence.
label_semantics.confusable: Relevant near-neighbor with an important condition liable to be confused with the task; not irrelevant or invalid.
label_semantics.insufficient_evidence: Insufficient inspected evidence for a role, not a negative label.
label_semantics.alternatives: Other valid documents may cover equivalent evidence. No single document is mandatory.
label_semantics.uncertainty: Taxonomy boundaries are discretionary, particularly TTT when preparation is allowed; tiers may change without factual changes.

evidence_location_contract.character_offsets: Python Unicode indexes; end exclusive after whitespace normalization
evidence_location_contract.quotes: At most 25 whitespace-delimited quoted words per paper; paraphrases reflect inspected conditions, not exhaustive summaries.

labels.title: Covariance-aware Feature Alignment with Pre-computed Source Statistics for Test-time Adaptation
labels.confidence_basis: Task-relative judgment, not calibrated probability or performance.
labels.task_relation: Retain core: closely matches source-prepared finite summaries and unlabeled target adaptation without deployment source examples. Core is not unchanged applicability to scalar regression.

conditions_and_limitations.source_summary_fit: Sections 3/4.1 and Algorithm 1 prepare means/covariances before deployment. Grouped statistics, not source examples, are exported.
conditions_and_limitations.storage: Section 4.3 gives d mean entries plus sum_i |G_i|^2 covariance entries, alongside grouping metadata. Preparation forms full d-by-d covariance. This is not a universal 150 KB cost or a task storage cap.
conditions_and_limitations.deterministic_scalar_fit: Full CAFe includes classification softmax infomax; it is not directly applicable unchanged to a deterministic scalar predictor. Feature-distribution Gaussians are NOT predictive regression distributions. Section 5.4 and Tables 1-3 explicitly include no-infomax ablation, so not every CAFe variant requires predictive class probabilities.
conditions_and_limitations.evidence_boundary: Inspected main and supplementary results concern image/digit classification, not the stated scalar-regression adaptation setting. Section 6 notes marginal alignment need not align conditional distributions. Reduced feature discrepancy is not guaranteed predictive improvement.
conditions_and_limitations.architecture_batch: Feature extraction, target batch support, group sizes and covariance conditioning matter. Allowed source preparation must not be confused with forbidden deployment source access.

evidence.quote: source dataset S cannot be accessed during TTA.

reading_scope.other_pages: Full-document page/keyword inspection located supplementary classification experiments and baselines. No exhaustive proof or numerical reproduction; bibliography not used as evidence.

labels.title: Source-free Domain Adaptation via Distributional Alignment by Matching Batch Normalization Statistics
labels.confidence_basis: Task-relative judgment, not calibrated probability or performance.
labels.task_relation: Retain core: independently supports source-free distribution alignment using stored source moments. Existing short rationale needs architecture/output qualifications rather than a tier change.

conditions_and_limitations.source_summary_fit: Selected BN source means/variances approximate unobserved source feature distributions. Adaptation uses target minibatches and the pretrained model, not source examples.
conditions_and_limitations.storage: Section 3.1 defines one source mean and variance per channel: O(C) retained moment scalars for the selected layer, in addition to model memory. This is a maintainer scaling inference, not a measured byte cost.
conditions_and_limitations.deterministic_scalar_fit: Per-channel feature-Gaussian alignment itself does not need probabilistic scalar predictions, but the complete objective also uses categorical classifier information maximization. Its one-hot/diversity logic does not directly apply to deterministic scalar outputs. Removing that term changes the complete method and does not inherit its results.
conditions_and_limitations.architecture_batch: Section 3 assumes at least one BN and a partition where BN starts the fixed classifier; encoder is adapted. An arbitrary scalar model need not expose this structure. Fixed source moment targets are not the same as overwriting source BN moments with target moments.
conditions_and_limitations.evidence_boundary: Sections 4.1-4.3 evaluate Office-31 and digit classification. Text warns that marginal feature alignment alone does not ensure discriminative features. Its classification risk-bound discussion does not establish arbitrary scalar-regression improvement.

reading_scope.other_pages: Pages 12-13 bibliography inspected as structure, not relevance truth. No independent equation/theorem validation.

labels.title: Layer Normalization
labels.confidence_basis: Task-relative judgment, not calibrated probability or performance.
labels.task_relation: Retain background: foundational distinction between per-example layer statistics and source/population/batch moments, plus learned gains and biases; not a source-summary adaptation method.

conditions_and_limitations.source_summary_fit: Section 3 computes moments across hidden units separately for each case, not precomputed aggregate source moments. Avoiding target minibatch dependence does not itself align target features with a retained source distribution.
conditions_and_limitations.deterministic_scalar_fit: The normalization operation need not require probabilistic output and can appear inside a deterministic predictor. That compatibility supplies neither a test-time adaptation objective nor evidence of improved scalar regression under shift.
conditions_and_limitations.evidence_boundary: The paper is NOT exclusively classification: inspected experiments include retrieval, sentence-representation downstream MSE, generative modeling and handwriting with mixture outputs. None establishes the specific source-summary/no-label adaptation claim.
conditions_and_limitations.parameter_distinction: Per-case means/variances are computed from activations, separate from learned gains/biases. Having affine parameters does not mean the original paper adapts them at test time.
conditions_and_limitations.storage: The described LN operation does not require an archive of source moments. This does not mean model or activation memory is zero.

evidence.quote: different training cases have different normalization terms
same computation at training and test times

reading_scope.other_pages: Definitions and invariance discussion closely read; experiment/supplement prose inspected. Plots/derivations not independently reproduced; references not primary evidence.

summary.important_qualification: Both alignment papers fit source-summary access but their complete methods include classification infomax. CAFe explicitly reports a no-infomax ablation. LN is per-case normalization, not itself source-summary adaptation.
summary.seven_IV_scope_papers: Not read or relabeled; remain SSA-unreviewed, not negative.
